bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, dengue has tragically claimed a child's life, leading the public to urge immediate government action.
The Supreme Court has ordered the demolition of 20 houses in Tiruvallur after cancelling pattas issued on waterbody poramboke land.
Anbumani Ramadoss has urged the Tamil Nadu government to officially notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release an integrated management plan.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre.
Equinix India announced plans to expand its Indian data centre capacity from 20 MW to 70 MW driven by AI demand.
The World Bank launched its first digital strategy focusing on AI and affordable internet to help create 1.2 billion jobs.

Immediate vector control measures and health department intervention are urgently demanded by residents.

The district administration must enforce the court directive and provide alternative resettlement sites.

stories.title: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong, Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Open CapitaLand’s First Chennai Data Centre
takeaways: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong and CM C Joseph Vijay unveiled CapitaLand's first data centre in Chennai.
The high-profile inauguration strengthens bilateral economic ties and expands Tamil Nadu digital infrastructure.

stories.title: Equinix India plans 70 MW data centre expansion driven by AI
takeaways: Equinix India plans to scale its data centre capacity from 20 MW to 70 MW.
The major expansion is driven by surging demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure in India.

stories.title: World Bank Launches First Digital Strategy: AI, Affordable Internet to Create 1.2 Billion Jobs
takeaways: The World Bank Group launched its first digital strategy focusing on AI and affordable internet access.
The initiative aims to create 1.2 billion jobs globally through enhanced digital connectivity.
